Ellen Perez (born 10 October 1995) is an Australian professional tennis player.
Her career-high rankings in singles and doubles are world No. 162 and No. 7, achieved in August 2019 and in April 2024, respectively.
She has won eight doubles titles on the WTA Tour , three doubles titles on the Challenger Tour , as well as two singles and 19 doubles titles on the ITF Circuit . Perez made her major main-draw debut at the 2016 Australian Open in doubles with Belinda Woolcock ; they lost in the first round to Jessica Moore and Storm Sanders . Perez made her first singles major appearance at the 2016 US Open , after winning the Australian Wildcard Play-off. Personal life [ edit ] Ellen is the daughter of John and Milića Perez.
